[Documentation](../../docs.html) / [Question types](../../docs.html#question-types)

Add a question, choose Ranking, and give the options to put in order.

![The respondents to rank options question selected in the editor, its settings outlined.](../../../docs/question-types/ranking-editor.png){width=100%}

## What the respondent sees

![The question as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/ranking-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Answer set.** The options. The answer is their order, first to last.

## Best practices for research

Rank 5 options or fewer: beyond that, the middle of a ranking says little.

Reference: Krosnick, J. A., & Presser, S. (2010). Question and questionnaire design. In P. V. Marsden & J. D. Wright (Eds.), *Handbook of survey research* (2nd ed., pp. 263-313). Emerald.
